bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/desktop.rs (GBM buffers exported as dma-bufs), springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (Presenter), springboard/src/bare/kms.rs (next_vsync), springboard/src/media/mod.rs (DmaBuf, DmaPicture)
summary: Core Video's buffer, pool, display-timing and GPU texture layers have counterparts in the Linux system layer (GBM and dma-buf buffers, a GPU presenter, vsync prediction), but no SDK API exposes them to apps. Apple's CVPixelBuffer, CVDisplayLink and CVImageBuffer attachment APIs have no app-facing equivalent.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/desktop.rs (GBM buffer exported as dma-buf, line 74 onward); springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (row-strided pixel view)
features.note: buffers exist in the system layer only; no SDK type wraps a locked base address with a pixel format

features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (create_surface with n buffers, add_drawable, pop_drawable)
features.note: the presenter keeps a fixed set of drawables per surface; no pool with minimum count, maximum age or allocation threshold is exposed to apps

features.feature: Image buffer attachments and colour metadata
features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/mod.rs (DmaPicture: stride, rows, crop_left, crop_top, width)
features.note: decoded pictures carry crop and stride only; no colour primaries, transfer function or YCbCr matrix attachments

features.feature: Pixel format description and fourcc types
features.bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/desktop.rs (Bo allocation takes a DRM fourcc); springboard/src/gpu/nv12.rs (NV12 planar path)
features.note: formats are DRM fourccs chosen internally; apps cannot register or query pixel format descriptions

features.feature: Display timing and vsync (CVDisplayLink, CVTime, CVTimeStamp)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/kms.rs (next_vsync, line 1014; DRM flip-complete timestamps); springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (App::next_wake, line 206)
features.note: vsync prediction is internal to the KMS path; the SDK ticks through next_wake, with no per-display callback and no refresh-period query. docs/bifrost-ui.md (around line 892) records the decision not to add CADisplayLink

features.apple: CVDisplayLink with OpenGL or Metal rendering, CVOpenGLBuffer, CVOpenGLBufferAttach
features.note: GPU-first presenter and scanout exist; apps do not render into presenter buffers through an SDK call

features.feature: Texture caches for GPU import (Metal, OpenGL, OpenGL ES)
features.note: dma-buf to GL texture import exists in the presenter; no cache object is offered to apps, and Metal has no Linux counterpart

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/wayland.rs (dma-buf wl_buffer around a presenter drawable, line 48); springboard/src/bare/scanout.rs (scanout render buffer)
features.note: shared memory between the GPU and the compositor is a system feature, not an app API; IOSurface itself is Apple-only

features.feature: Core Video result codes and error type
features.note: CVReturn is an Apple-specific code space; BifrOSt uses Rust Result and io::Error

gaps: No SDK pixel buffer type (lock, base address, bytes per row, plane access) for apps; buffers exist only inside the presenter.
No display link API: apps get next_wake ticks, with no per-display output callback or refresh-period query.
No image buffer attachments: colour primaries, transfer function, YCbCr matrix and clean aperture are not carried on decoded pictures (springboard/src/media/mod.rs DmaPicture).
No app-facing pixel buffer pool with minimum count, maximum age and allocation threshold.
No texture cache API for apps to import pixel buffers as GPU textures.
